name: NetworkFortigateTraffic
description: FortiGate firewall traffic (forward session) logs. Ref: https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.6/fortios-log-message-reference/357866/log-message-fields

fields.name: TimeGenerated
fields.description: Event timestamp (UTC). Raw: eventtime (epoch nanoseconds). Conversion: eventtime / 1000000 → INT64 epoch milliseconds. Fallback: parse date + time if eventtime is absent.

fields.name: _Size
fields.description: Internal record size in bytes, used for ingestion accounting. Not sourced from FortiGate.

fields.name: _Type
fields.description: The name of the table/index. This field will be set by the index engine.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Day, month, and year when the log was recorded. Raw: date (string).

fields.name: time
fields.description: Hour clock when the log was recorded. Raw: time (string).

fields.name: eventtime
fields.description: Epoch time in nanoseconds the log was triggered by FortiGate. May differ slightly from date/time due to recording delay. Raw: eventtime (epoch nanoseconds). Conversion: stored as INT64.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Message/packet direction. Raw: direction (string).

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Duration of the session, in seconds. Raw: duration (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: sessionid
fields.description: ID for the session. Raw: sessionid (long). Conversion: long → INT64.

fields.name: vd
fields.description: Name of the virtual domain in which the log was recorded. Raw: vd (string).

fields.name: transport
fields.description: NAT source port. Raw: transport (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: srcip
fields.description: IP address of the traffic's origin. Raw: srcip (string, IPv4/IPv6).

fields.name: transip
fields.description: NAT source IP. Raw: transip (string, IPv4/IPv6).

fields.name: srcport
fields.description: Port number of the traffic's origin. Raw: srcport (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: srccountry
fields.description: Name of the source country. Raw: srccountry (string).

fields.name: srcintf
fields.description: Interface name of the traffic's origin. Raw: srcintf (string).

fields.name: srcname
fields.description: Name of the source. Raw: srcname (string).

fields.name: srcintfrole
fields.description: Role of the source interface. Raw: srcintfrole (string).

fields.name: devtype
fields.description: Device type of the source. Raw: devtype (string).

fields.name: osname
fields.description: OS of the source. Raw: osname (string).

fields.name: mastersrcmac
fields.description: Master MAC address for a host with multiple network interfaces. Raw: mastersrcmac (string).

fields.name: srcmac
fields.description: MAC address associated with the source IP address. Raw: srcmac (string).

fields.name: srcserver
fields.description: Server of the source. Raw: srcserver (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: devid
fields.description: Serial number of the device for the traffic's origin. Raw: devid (string).

fields.name: devname
fields.description: Name of the device for the traffic's origin. Raw: devname (string).

fields.name: dstip
fields.description: Destination IP address. Raw: dstip (string, IPv4/IPv6).

fields.name: dstport
fields.description: Port number of the traffic's destination. Raw: dstport (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: dstcountry
fields.description: Name of the destination country. Raw: dstcountry (string).

fields.name: dstintf
fields.description: Interface of the traffic's destination. Raw: dstintf (string).

fields.name: dstname
fields.description: Name of the destination. Raw: dstname (string).

fields.name: dstintfrole
fields.description: Role of the destination interface. Raw: dstintfrole (string).

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Human-readable log message text. Raw: msg (string).

fields.name: app
fields.description: Name of the application. Raw: app (string).

fields.name: appcat
fields.description: Category of the application. Raw: appcat (string).

fields.name: service
fields.description: Name of the service. Raw: service (string).

fields.name: appid
fields.description: ID of the application. Raw: appid (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: apprisk
fields.description: Risk level of the application. Raw: apprisk (string).

fields.name: countapp
fields.description: Number of App Ctrl logs associated with the session. Raw: countapp (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: rcvdbyte
fields.description: Number of bytes received. Raw: rcvdbyte (long). Conversion: long → INT64.

fields.name: rcvdpkt
fields.description: Number of packets received. Raw: rcvdpkt (long). Conversion: long → INT64.

fields.name: sentbyte
fields.description: Number of bytes sent. Raw: sentbyte (long). Conversion: long → INT64.

fields.name: sentpkt
fields.description: Number of packets sent. Raw: sentpkt (long). Conversion: long → INT64.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Status of the session. Deny: blocked by firewall policy; Start: session start; otherwise allowed and value indicates how the session closed. Raw: action (string).

fields.name: policyid
fields.description: ID of the firewall policy governing the traffic. Raw: policyid (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: poluuid
fields.description: UUID for the firewall policy. Raw: poluuid (string).

fields.name: policytype
fields.description: Policy type. Raw: policytype (string).

fields.name: policymode
fields.description: Firewall policy mode. Raw: policymode (string).

fields.name: level
fields.description: Security level rating. Raw: level (string).

fields.name: proto
fields.description: IP protocol number (6=TCP, 17=UDP, etc.). Raw: proto (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Log type. See https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.6/fortios-log-message-reference/374445/type. Raw: type (string).

fields.name: logid
fields.description: Log ID. See https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.6/fortios-log-message-reference/656858/log-id-definitions. Raw: logid (string).

fields.name: subtype
fields.description: Subtype of the traffic. See https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.6/fortios-log-message-reference/195419/subtype. Raw: subtype (string).

fields.name: trandisp
fields.description: NAT translation type. Raw: trandisp (string).

fields.name: tz
fields.description: Timezone offset of the log timestamp (e.g. -0800, +0000). Raw: tz (string).

fields.name: utmaction
fields.description: Security action performed by UTM. Raw: utmaction (string).

fields.name: utmref
fields.description: UTM reference number. Raw: utmref (string; may be a compound value like N-NNNNNN).

fields.name: _fields
fields.description: Extended fields not modeled as top-level columns. Contents vary by logid (each FortiGate traffic subtype emits its own set of extra key=value pairs). Raw: remainder of the log line after the modeled fields are extracted. Conversion: serialized as a JSON object and stored as UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint so KQL can walk it with . and [] operators.
